title: Potential at D
description: Essential: Correctly calculates φ_D = -E * (distance from D to B) = -1.2e2 V/m * 0.005 m = -0.6 V.

title: Potential Difference C-D
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U_CD = φ_C - φ_D, with φ_C = -E * (distance from C to B) = -1.2e2 V/m * 0.045 m = -5.4 V, yielding -4.8 V.

title: Capacitance Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates C = Q / |U_AB|, using Q = 6e-8 C and U_AB = E * d = 6 V, yielding 5e-10 F (or 0.5 nF).

title: Use of Ground Definition
description: Important: Recognizes that plate B being grounded sets its potential to 0 V, which is the reference for all other potentials.

title: Uniform Field Relation
description: Important: Applies ΔV = -E * Δx correctly for points within the field, noting the negative sign indicates potential decreases in the direction of the field.

title: Correct Distance Identification
description: Important: Uses correct distances from points to the grounded plate (B) for potential calculations: 0.5 cm for D, 4.5 cm for C.

title: Sign Error in Potential
description: Pitfall: Omits the negative sign in ΔV = -EΔx or misinterprets the direction of the field, leading to positive potentials.

title: Unit Conversion Error
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert distances from cm to meters before multiplying by the electric field strength.

title: Voltage for Capacitance
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong potential difference (e.g., U_CD) in the capacitance formula C = Q/U instead of the full plate voltage U_AB.
